classification.Preserved: All required public-language observations for the case are established with an attributable witness.
classification.Violated: At least one required observation differs, with a witness naming the observable and actual result.
classification.Unknown: Identity, execution, parsing, extraction, dependency, or budget prevents a sound decision. Unknown is fail-closed and cannot satisfy a mandatory case or reject a mutation.

observables.O-BINDING: math.root is a callable function in the closed math module and is distinct from math.sqrt and bare syntax.
observables.O-SIGNATURE: Successful qualified calls consume exactly index then radicand positionally; index accepts Content or none, radicand accepts Content with the established none-to-empty coercion, and measured invalid calls preserve their public diagnostic fragments.
observables.O-CARRIER-THREE-STATES: MathRoot stores index, radicand, and causal index_explicit so absent None/false, explicit none None/true, and present content Some(_)/true remain distinct, including Some(Empty)/true.
observables.O-BARE-SYNTAX: Bare root requires index and radicand slots, preserves empty index as Some(Empty)/true and evaluated none as None/true; sqrt produces None/false.
observables.O-BILATERAL-CONVERGENCE: Equivalent bare root and qualified math.root calls converge on the same carrier, repr morphology, and established layout result without one route rewriting the other.
observables.O-WALKERS: Clone, hash, structural equality, map_content, and terminal map_text preserve index_explicit; map_content recurses only through index and radicand, and plain_text remains value-based.
observables.O-OBSERVATION-RELATION: ObservationEq compares index_explicit nominally: carriers differing only in causal presence are Different, identical complete carriers are Same, and no such pair is Unproven.
observables.O-REPR: None/false emits root(radicand: ...), Some(index)/true emits root(index: ..., radicand: ...), and None/true emits root(index: none, radicand: ...); field order and child repr are stable.
observables.O-RECONSTRUCTION: apply_math_default and apply_math_style recurse as before while transporting index_explicit nominally.
observables.O-LAYOUT-INERTNESS: index_explicit changes no radical geometry, class, text, emptiness, baseline, or dispatch; index and radicand retain established layout semantics.
observables.O-SQRT-CONTROL: math.sqrt and sqrt syntax remain one-radicand square-root producers with None/false and root(radicand: ...) morphology.
observables.O-FAIL-CLOSED: Only deliberately opaque cases may classify Unknown; Unknown blocks every mandatory case and gives no mutation credit.
